scientific_question: Can the accepted Hindsight revision be reduced to a source-authoritative, project-owned runtime package set without changing method code or including unrelated interfaces, tests, and documentation?
decision_informed: Whether Hindsight can proceed to a dedicated dependency environment and embedded-service lifecycle gate.
scientific_evidence_role: engineering source-copy gate only; no import, service, lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim is permitted

copy_scope.authority: Git-tracked files at the frozen source revision only
copy_scope.excluded: tests, docs, frontend/control-plane packages, integrations, examples, Docker/Helm assets, Git metadata, untracked files, bytecode, symlinks, and all other repository paths

execution_contract.wave1_non_interference: This small source-only copy may run while Wave-1 is active because it performs no network access, dependency installation, model download, model load, API call, service start, or GPU operation.

acceptance: The accepted source checkout resolves to the exact frozen revision and is clean.
Only selected Git-tracked regular files are copied.
The destination and evidence roots were absent before execution.
The result contains exactly 563 files and 9417481 bytes.
No copied relative path contains __pycache__ and no copied file ends in .pyc.
Every copied file has a retained relative path, byte size, and SHA-256.
The evidence root has TERMINAL_ACCEPTED, no TERMINAL_REJECTED, and a verified evidence inventory.
failure: Any collision, source identity mismatch, dirty source, non-regular selected file, cardinality mismatch, copy error, bytecode inclusion, or timeout seals a fresh TERMINAL_REJECTED root and retains the partial destination.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit the execution copy, then freeze a dedicated Python 3.11 dependency environment. This stage never authorizes model acquisition, import, service, lifecycle, or numerical execution.
prohibited_actions: editing the accepted official source checkout
copying untracked, test, documentation, integration, bytecode, symlink, or model files
installing dependencies, downloading models, calling an LLM, starting pg0, binding a port, or using a GPU
starting a lifecycle or numerical run
deleting or repairing a rejected destination in place
populating any comparison-table numeric cell from this gate
